collection.title: Fiat Fiorino 1988 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Fiat Fiorino 1988 to 2001 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
